tasks.behavior: Docs and code text keep their place on Linux and Android while the fonts load
acceptance: On Chromium for Linux, /docs at 1440 px with every font file arriving late shifts less than 0.01
notes: 2026-10-30 review fail by reviewer: Root cause confirmed in the Linux browser (pw-linux-fonts): main's fonts.ts and globals.css fail docs.spec.ts:85 at 0.0889, HEAD passes. Main's build has next/font's face 'Hanken Grotesk Fallback; src local(Arial); 99.07% / 30.02% / 0.0% / 100.94%', so the copied overrides are exact. HEAD resolves --fw-font-sans-loaded to '"Hanken Grotesk", Hanken Grotesk Fallback' and --fw-font-sans still ends in system-ui, sans-serif. Lighthouse: 98 / 100 / LCP 1862 ms. check-docs: 0 errors. Docs lines are within 25 words. The test rename names what it holds. The kit select test fails the same way on main's code in that browser (scrollbar 0), so it comes from connect mode. Defect: display optional with subsets ['latin'] preloads only the latin Hanken face. In Chromium, an optional face that starts loading after the first paint is never used in that document. Linux probe on HEAD: text added after load ('Łukasz Wiśniewski'), latin-ext face fetched in 9 ms, still 'Liberation Sans:2, Hanken Grotesk:15' for the document's life (client navigations included). Hanken only shows after a reload. On main (swap) the same probe renders all Hanken. So client-rendered names with Polish, Czech, Turkish, Romanian or Hungarian letters mix two fonts inside one word, even on a fast connection. fonts.ts, DESIGN.md and the commit say a face shows when it arrives in the short wait, which is not true for these faces. Fix tried: subsets ['latin', 'latin-ext'] makes the probe all Hanken, keeps the shift test at 3 of 3 on Linux, and Lighthouse reads 98 / 100 / LCP 1946 ms. Then say in the docs which subsets are preloaded. Note: Noto Sans (document previews) still uses next's Arial-only fallback with swap. That is the same Linux fallback bug, limited to previews. Fix it or name it.

Fallback faces read 'loaded' on Linux at HEAD; main on 3700 reads 'error' for both. Noto overrides 100.54/27.56/0/106.33 and Hanken's 99.07/30.02/0/100.94 match main's next/font CSS. docs.spec.ts passed in the Linux browser (6/6), font test 3/3 with --repeat-each 3.
